title: Product Monte Carlo: Expectation Under a Product of Densities
abstract: arXiv:2610.12702v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Aggregating independently computed sub-sample inferences is a well-known challenge in large-scale Bayesian computation, federated learning, and opinion pooling. The core problem is to approximate a distribution whose density is proportional to a product of individual densities. We propose Product Monte Carlo (PMC), an algorithm for computing arbitrary expectations under a product of densities using only Monte Carlo draws from individual densities. We turn the intractable product expectation into a regression problem by expressing it through a family of computable conditional expectations. Besides the point estimate, our fully Bayesian regression formulation provides coherent uncertainty quantification and principled diagnostics. We establish theoretical guarantees on consistency and characterize convergence rates for the PMC estimator. translated_title: 乘积蒙特卡罗：密度乘积下的期望计算
translated_abstract: 聚合独立计算的子样本推断是大规模贝叶斯计算、联邦学习和意见汇聚领域公认的难题。其核心问题是近似一个密度正比于各个体密度乘积的分布。我们提出了乘积蒙特卡罗（Product Monte Carlo, PMC），这是一种仅利用来自各个体密度的蒙特卡罗样本、即可计算密度乘积下任意期望的算法。我们通过一族可计算的条件期望，将难以直接处理的乘积期望转化为一个回归问题。除了点估计之外，我们的全贝叶斯回归框架还提供了连贯的不确定性量化以及有原则的诊断方法。我们为PMC估计量建立了一致性方面的理论保证，并刻画了其收敛速率。在改变子样本数量、维度和异质性的模拟与真实数据实验中，该方法均表现出良好效果。
tldr: 该论文提出乘积蒙特卡罗（PMC）算法，通过将难以处理的密度乘积期望转化为全贝叶斯回归问题，仅利用各分量密度的蒙特卡罗样本即可计算任意期望，并具备一致性保证与不确定性量化能力。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Product Monte Carlo (PMC), an algorithm that computes arbitrary expectations under a product of densities using only Monte Carlo draws from individual densities, by reformulating the intractable product expectation as a fully Bayesian regression problem with theoretical consistency guarantees and uncertainty quantification.
